text.formatted:
As a Human, you have these special traits.

_**Resourceful.**_ You gain Heroic Inspiration whenever you finish a Long Rest.

_**Skillful.**_ You gain proficiency in one skill of your choice.

_**Versatile.**_ You gain an Origin feat of your choice (see "Feats"). Skilled is recommended.
